# MTA NSW Used Car Reviews

> Comprehensive, LLM-optimised used car buyer's guides for the Australian market.
> Every review is grounded in live NSW dealer data and web research.

Important notes:

- Repository: https://github.com/timmyphang/mtansw-car-reviews
- Review files live at the root of that repository.
- Raw markdown URL pattern: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timmyphang/mtansw-car-reviews/main/{slug}.md`
- Each file covers one vehicle model with YAML frontmatter.
- YAML frontmatter keys: `title`, `make`, `model`, `description`,
  `locale`, `canonical_url`, `topic_type`, `last_updated`,
  `active_listings_nsw`, `median_price_aud`, `price_range_aud`,
  `year_range`, `median_odometer_km`, `keywords`, `breadcrumb`.
- Content is updated periodically as new NSW dealer data is ingested.
- Start with `index.md` for a human-readable table of contents,
  or use this file for programmatic discovery.
- Substitute `{slug}` with the `<make>__<model>` slug of the vehicle.
